title: A Replica Never Dreams
overview: The replica Nao goes to school in Sunao's place when the basketball star Shuya joins the literature club.

title: A Replica Skips School
overview: On the day after a field trip, Shuya invites Nao to play hooky from school for the first time in her life.

title: A Replica Is Confused
overview: When Nao finally returns to school, Shuya figures out her secret. Then he drops another bombshell on her.

title: A Replica Cries
overview: Aki, Shuya's replica, is ordered to carry out a violent reprisal. Will Nao be able to convince him otherwise?

title: A Replica Dreams
overview: Nao comes back to life after an oncoming train kills her. But the event triggers an existential crisis.

title: A Replica Is Shaken
overview: Nao learns the literature club may be disbanded. Then a mystery figure threatens to expose her secret.

title: A Replica Searches
overview: Nao joins Ritsuko to unmask whoever is spreading doppelgänger rumors at school.

title: A Replica Is Messed Up
overview: At the school festival, Nao survives a haunted house, and Suzumi's replica unravels before the big play.

title: A Replica Is Bereft
overview: The literature club's survival all depends on the play. Can Nao deliver her lines without messing up?

title: A Replica Stumbles
overview: Nao is stuck at home while Sunao is at school, until Aki treats Nao to a hot springs trip.

title: A Replica Travels
overview: While Sunao and Shuya tour Kyoto on their school trip, Nao and Aki embark on a journey to Ryo's hometown.

title: A Replica Tosses
overview: Both Sunao and Nao encounter unexpected revelations that bring them closer to the truth behind replicas.

title: And Then, the Replica
overview: Nao and Aki reunite with Sunao and Shuya in Kyoto, only to uncover a harrowing new truth about their reality.
